items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Always full of that next stair and Joyce Lewis and the shed falling in.

ctx.x: Yeah, yes. The ambulance taking one or two to the, to the hospital. But I learned that there wasn't, nothing too serious. So I was glad for that. And the ambulance couldn't, the crowd was so, the ambulance couldn't pass by. This was brushing up against the people, moving and blowing to get out, you know. And we had a time getting out there. And I never saw so many photographers before in my life. It looked like they had 200 or more there. And they were taking pictures in the newspapers. And they were always full…
They may still be here. I don't know.
